teacher: Best of four SRPT-start searches with 8192 proposals; feasible, not certified optimal
states: Teacher and srpt:128 trajectories for each physical workload
target: Soft listwise action values from exact final costs after forcing each currently feasible action and retaining the trajectory continuation order
serving: One static PyTorch encoder call; extracted NumPy dynamic head at every ready-set decision
training: Hidden16, two layers, AdamW 0.001, 30 epochs, three seeds; actual served validation-cost selection every five epochs
validation_bar: At least 5 percent mean gain over srpt:128 and p95 full decision time at or below 5 ms for every GNN draw
live_gate: 32 sealed workloads times nine learned arms, srpt:128, teacher and plain srpt = 384 actual HeROsim runs
claim_bar: GNN paired median gain at least 5 percent over MP-OFF, hand-graph and srpt:128, positive bootstrap lower bounds, all GNN draws within 5 ms
stop: Do not scale if outcome-aware GNN fails either the objective bar or both matched controls
